marking.criterion: Traffic change: growth in prompt tokens per request or the prompt:output ratio (e.g. RAG adoption)
Leading metric: ρ_prefill (prefill share of iterations) and ITL p99 rising before TTFT breaches
A concrete threshold (e.g. ρ_prefill > 0.55 or ITL p99 > 2x baseline sustained)
